label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A region-redirect dialog opened with no focus placed on it; I had to hunt for the Close Modal button, which sits inside an embedded frame.

After pressing Continue the main area was empty and nothing announced loading; a newsletter promo dialog then appeared with no close button, only a button called Open Another Modal, and I had to guess Escape.

The three plan buttons give no selected state when pressed, so I could not tell which plan was chosen. Book Bundles add-on is pre-checked at an extra $20 per kit, and the whole add-on is a button holding a checkbox.

element.name: $88 per Play Kit Pay when each Play Kit ships

findings.problem: Pressing Continue gave no feedback; the page stayed the same until I read again and found the cart page, so I did not know whether it worked.
The cart heading says 3 items but the cart summary bar says 2 items, and a free gift I never chose is included, which is confusing to hear.
